text: Rejected the mechanical swap of '(delivered, immutable)' to '(signed, immutable)' on the six Extends declarations. It replaced a stale claim with a false one: nothing is signed, so calling PAWL-001 signed asserts a state that does not exist. Dropped the parenthetical instead — the Extends relationship and the criterion-by-criterion table are the content, and the immutability note was decoration explaining a constraint that no longer applies.
